message.content:
Here are some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller movies released in 2020:

| # | Title | Director(s) | Notable Cast | Why it stands out |
|---|-------|-------------|--------------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern take on the classic horror story, blending psychological thriller elements with a strong feminist angle. |
| 2 | **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam, Michelle Dockery | Ritchie's signature fast‑paced dialogue and stylish visuals, combined with a sharp plot about drug‑trade turf wars. |
| 3 | **The Night Clerk** | Daniel Kwan | John Krasinski, Olivia Cooke | A tense, claustrophobic thriller that explores paranoia and identity through a single night in a hotel. |
| 4 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Lie Kaas | A Danish film that uses a crime‑thriller framework to examine social ostracism and moral panic. |
| 5 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | Though more historical drama, its courtroom showdown and moral ambiguity give it a thriller edge. |
| 6 | **The Devil All the Time** | Antonio Campos | Tom Holland, Anya Taylor‑Joy, Riley Keough | A bleak, atmospheric crime‑drama that blends multiple interlocking stories into a chilling narrative. |
| 7 | **The White Tiger** | Ramin Bahrani | Adarsh Gourav, Rajkummar Rao | A darkly comedic crime‑thriller that follows an ambitious driver’s rise to power in India. |
| 8 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II | A courtroom drama that doubles as a political thriller, capturing the tension of the 1969 protest trial. |
| 9 | **The Last Full Measure** | David Frankel | Chris Evans, Tom Hanks, Ben Affleck | A war‑drama that incorporates investigative thriller elements as it tells the story of a Medal of Honor investigation. |
|10 | **The Last House on the Left** | Eli Roth | Lili Reinhart, Dylan Minnette | A controversial, visceral crime‑thriller that pushes the boundaries of shock value and revenge. |

These films were praised for their direction, performances, and the way they kept audiences on edge throughout. If you’re looking for something specific—like a sub‑genre focus or a particular director—just let me know!
